questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes covalent bonding?

options.text: Electrons are transferred from a metal to a non-metal
Protons are shared between two atoms
Electrons are shared between non-metal atoms
Electrons are delocalised across a lattice of positive ions

questions.explanation: Covalent bonding occurs between non-metal atoms. The atoms share pairs of electrons so that both atoms achieve full outer shells. This is different from ionic bonding (electron transfer) and metallic bonding (delocalised electrons).
